subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

The woman __to who I sold__ my house was a criminal.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of "who" instead of "whom."
 
• **"Whom" **is used as the object of a verb or preposition.
 
• The correct phrase should be "to whom I sold," ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is in the underlined segment "to who."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The woman to** whom **I sold my house was a criminal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) No substitution** – This option would be correct if the original sentence was already grammatically correct, which it is not.
 
• **3) to whom I sell** – This option is incorrect because the verb "sell" is in the present tense, while the context requires the past tense "sold."
 
• **4) to whom sold** – This option is incorrect because it lacks the subject "I."
